options_evaluated: Monolithic unreinforced polycarbonate shell with mechanical fasteners
Die-cast magnesium alloy with no soft-touch coatings
assessments.recommendation: Monolithic unreinforced polycarbonate shell with mechanical fasteners
assessments.rationale: This option avoids the use of overmolded elastomers which degrade and peel under friction during operation, releasing microplastics and nanoplastics (Parameter (p), Page 80). A monolithic polycarbonate shell ensures high durability and resistance to drop stresses (Parameter (a), Page 79) and facilitates ease of repair and maintenance (Parameter (b), Page 79) by allowing easy disassembly without tearing soft-touch coatings.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Pre-use and Manufacturing stages due to higher raw material costs and the aesthetic preference for soft-touch grips which are popular in marketing.
espr_parameters: (a) durability and reliability of the product and its components
(p) microplastic and nanoplastic released by using the product

options_evaluated: Threaded metal inserts with standard Torx screws
assessments.recommendation: Threaded metal inserts with standard Torx screws
assessments.rationale: Using threaded metal inserts with standard Torx screws directly supports ease of repair and maintenance (Parameter (b), Page 79) and compatibility with commonly available tools (Page 79, Page 8). It prevents premature obsolescence (Page 27) caused by stripped plastic threads during repeated disassembly and reassembly, thereby extending the technical lifetime and durability (Parameter (a), Page 79) of the screwdriver during its active service life.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage due to increased assembly complexity, longer cycle times, and higher bill-of-materials cost for metal inserts.
espr_parameters: (a) durability and reliability of the product and its components

options_evaluated: Brushed DC motor with integrated gearbox
Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with digital speed control
Pneumatic vane motor with external coupling
assessments.recommendation: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with digital speed control
assessments.rationale: A brushless DC motor significantly enhances the durability and reliability (Parameter (a), Page 79) of the screwdriver by eliminating carbon brush wear, which is a primary failure mechanism that limits technical lifetime (Page 79). It also improves energy efficiency and reduces energy consumption during service (Parameter (g), Page 79, Page 3), while optimizing functional performance and conditions for use (Parameter (s), Page 80) through precise torque control.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage due to the high cost of electronic controllers, sensors, and rare-earth magnets, and End-of-Life stage due to the complexity of recycling printed circuit boards.
espr_parameters: (a) durability and reliability of the product and its components
(g) use or consumption of energy, water and other resources while in service
(s) functional performance and conditions for use

options_evaluated: Active fan cooling with open ventilation slots
Passive conduction via internal heat sinks and sealed housing
assessments.recommendation: Passive conduction via internal heat sinks and sealed housing
assessments.rationale: Active fan cooling with open slots allows dust, moisture, and debris to enter the tool during operation, which degrades internal components and reduces reliability and technical lifetime (Parameter (a), Page 79). A sealed housing with passive conduction protects the motor and electronics, ensuring reliable functional performance under harsh conditions of use (Parameter (s), Page 80) and preventing premature failure, which would generate premature waste (Parameter (r), Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage due to increased weight and cost of metal heat sinks, and Pre-use stage due to design complexity to ensure effective thermal transfer through a sealed shell.
espr_parameters: (a) durability and reliability of the product and its components
(r) amounts of waste generated by using the product
(s) functional performance and conditions for use

options_evaluated: Modular architecture with separate plug-and-play modules (switch, motor, battery, BMS)
Semi-modular design with soldered wire connections
assessments.recommendation: Modular architecture with separate plug-and-play modules (switch, motor, battery, BMS)
assessments.rationale: A highly modular architecture directly enhances the ease of repair and maintenance (Parameter (b), Page 79) by allowing professional repairers (Page 29) or users to replace only the defective module instead of the entire tool, preventing premature obsolescence (Page 27). This ensures high availability and accessibility of spare parts (Parameter (l), Page 79) and reduces the amount of waste generated by using the product (Parameter (r), Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage due to higher production cost, increased volume and weight of internal connectors, and complex assembly, and Pre-use stage due to a larger physical footprint of the tool.
espr_parameters: (l) availability and accessibility of consumables and spare parts
(r) amounts of waste generated by using the product

options_evaluated: Removable and standardized slide-on Lithium-ion battery pack
assessments.recommendation: Removable and standardized slide-on Lithium-ion battery pack
assessments.rationale: A removable and standardized battery pack ensures that when the battery reaches its end of technical life, it can be easily replaced without discarding the tool, directly supporting durability (Parameter (a), Page 79), ease of repair (Parameter (b), Page 79), and availability of consumables/spare parts (Parameter (l), Page 79). It also allows interoperability (Page 79) with other tools and minimizes waste generated during the product's service life (Parameter (r), Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Pre-use stage because it requires standardized interface agreements across brands, and Manufacturing stage due to increased casing material for the battery pack, adding weight and volume.
espr_parameters: (a) durability and reliability of the product and its components
(l) availability and accessibility of consumables and spare parts
(r) amounts of waste generated by using the product
